title: Find What Is Shared · The Twin Cats

Preserve exactly two separate bodies and one continuous tail, with the tail base, bodies, paws and seated positions fixed. Settle at last.png. No extra tail, duplicate body or limbs, new props, text, digits, runes, math, diagrams, praise, sparkle, morphing, sound, music or lip sync.
